Then, on July 29 of this year, the Senate finally subpoenaed him. He raised his right hand and took the Fifth Amendment. Not once, and not twice. **He took it 111 times.**
You gave up two years of your life on his word. He would not give thirty seconds of honest testimony on yours. That is not science. That is contempt for you.
And let me be blunt, because I have never been anything else. **This man is not a scientist who made an honest mistake. He is a criminal who ran a cover-up** , and the wreckage of your business, your church and your family was the price of it. **Innocent men do not take the Fifth 111 times.** [**Stand with me and help fund this case.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e805273/VaHR0cHM6Ly9mcmVlZG9td2F0Y2gucmV2di5jby9mdy0xNS1kYXlzLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA4MjE/LbmNsOVJEU0dYWQ/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZnctMTUtZGF5cyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPW9tJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYiZ1dG1fdGVybT0yMzQ4M193cjEmYW1vdW50PTI1/gaohTIA/sftc6d9cf7b)
My name is Larry Klayman. I founded Judicial Watch, I served as a federal prosecutor, and in more than 40 years of legal warfare I became the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting president committed a crime.
Today I run Freedom Watch, and we have something the Senate does not: **an active federal lawsuit in Dallas, Texas over COVID-19.** We filed it in March 2020 against the Chinese Communist Party and its Wuhan lab, seeking trillions in damages for a nationwide class of victims, and **that class could include you.**
I am now amending that complaint to add Anthony Fauci as a defendant, along with former so-called President Joe Biden, to invalidate the phony and illegal pardon that the **Biden Crime Family** slipped him in the dead of night. That question could go all the way to the Supreme Court, and this case may be the only vehicle to take it there. [**Fund the amended complaint against Fauci and Biden.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e805273/VaHR0cHM6Ly9mcmVlZG9td2F0Y2gucmV2di5jby9mdy0xNS1kYXlzLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA4MjE/LbmNsOVJEU0dYWQ/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZnctMTUtZGF5cyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPW9tJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYiZ1dG1fdGVybT0yMzQ4M193cjEmYW1vdW50PTI1/gaohTIA/sftc6d9cf7b)
"But didn't Biden pardon him?"
**A pardon is no defense to a civil lawsuit.** It stops a prosecutor, and nothing more. It cannot stop a jury from ordering Fauci to pay damages for what he did. In my courtroom that pardon is a **worthless scrap of paper.**
And that midnight pardon has a problem of its own. The House Oversight Committee found that Biden's last-minute pardons were signed by autopen — by a machine — with no proof that Biden even knew about them, and declared them null and void. The Supreme Court said more than a century ago that accepting a pardon carries "a confession" of guilt. So we will ask the court to strike that pardon down, **and we will go after Joe Biden for issuing it.**
Better still, a jury in a civil case is allowed by binding Supreme Court precedent to hold a defendant's silence against him as evidence that he is liable. **He handed us Exhibit A, 111 times over.**
Senator Paul says he will hold a contempt vote, and God bless him for trying. But you and I both know exactly how that ends: the filibuster will kill it, and official Washington will protect its own. The Senate has not successfully held anyone in contempt since 1971.
**That is why Freedom Watch exists. We are your real Justice Department** — because the one in Washington has been inert, and the Senate is a debating society with a coat check.
Congressional hearings produce headlines and press releases, while federal lawsuits produce subpoenas, sworn testimony, documentary evidence and enforceable judgments. Missouri already won a **$24 billion** judgment against China over COVID and is moving to seize Chinese assets to collect it, so do not tell me this cannot be done.
But a fight of this size is **WAR** , and war costs money. Freedom Watch is a 501(c)(3), **your gift is tax-deductible,** and every dollar goes straight into this case. [**Give $25, $50, $100 or more right now.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e805273/VaHR0cHM6Ly9mcmVlZG9td2F0Y2gucmV2di5jby9mdy0xNS1kYXlzLW1iLW9tLw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA4MjE/LbmNsOVJEU0dYWQ/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZnctMTUtZGF5cyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPW9tJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYiZ1dG1fdGVybT0yMzQ4M193cjEmYW1vdW50PTI1/gaohTIA/sftc6d9cf7b)
You gave them two years, and they never asked. I am asking. Give me one gift, and I will haul these people into court and get you the answers they owe you.
In Justice,Larry Klayman Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch Chairman and General Counsel, Freedom Watch, Inc.
P.S. ****You lost a business, a funeral, a church, or two years of your child's life — and he took the Fifth 111 times rather than tell you why. In civil court, that silence can be used against him. We file within weeks, and I want your name standing with mine when we do.

Do you remember what your street sounded like that spring? Nothing at all — no traffic, no children playing outside, no church bells on Sunday morning. Only sirens, running all day and into the night, and the sound of your own television counting the dead. Do you remember the plywood going up over the storefronts downtown? The caution tape wrapped around the swing sets? The arrows taped to the floor of the grocery store, and the man who shouted at you for standing too close to him in the aisle? Fifteen days eventually became two years. So let me ask you the question that nobody in Washington has ever bothered to ask you. What did those two years take from you? Not from the country. From you. Maybe it was the business — thirty years of your life invested in it, and then a paper sign taped to the glass. The big chain store down the road stayed open and sold the very same goods, because yours was ruled "non-essential." Some of you never opened those doors again. Maybe it was your father's funeral, with only ten mourners permitted, while you watched your own father buried through a telephone screen at your kitchen table. Maybe it was your church, chained shut on Easter Sunday while the state government announced that the liquor store and the casino could remain open for business. I sued over exactly that, because congregations were treated as a public menace while gambling halls ran all night. Maybe it was your children — two years staring at a laptop, a child who now reads two grades behind, a graduation year that simply never happened, and a teenager who has never really been the same since. Maybe it was your mother in the nursing home. Ten months of waving at her through a window, and near the end she no longer knew who was waving. You did all of it. You closed up your business, you stayed inside your home, and you buried people alone, because you were repeatedly assured that there was no alternative. Now here is what that man was doing while you obeyed. Senator Rand Paul released 1,100 pages of Anthony Fauci's private diary. In his own words, written at the time, Fauci kept "an open mind about the possibility of a lab leak" — while publicly branding that same idea a conspiracy theory and smearing anyone who dared to raise it. People like you. People like me. So while you sat in that parking lot, the man giving the orders privately had his doubts, and he simply never shared a single one of them with you. | | | | | Then, on July 29 of this year, the Senate finally subpoenaed him. He raised his right hand and took the Fifth Amendment. Not once, and not twice. He took it 111 times. You gave up two years of your life on his word. He would not give thirty seconds of honest testimony on yours. That is not science. That is contempt for you. And let me be blunt, because I have never been anything else. This man is not a scientist who made an honest mistake. He is a criminal who ran a cover-up , and the wreckage of your business, your church and your family was the price of it. Innocent men do not take the Fifth 111 times. My name is Larry Klayman. I founded Judicial Watch, I served as a federal prosecutor, and in more than 40 years of legal warfare I became the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting president committed a crime. Today I run Freedom Watch, and we have something the Senate does not: an active federal lawsuit in Dallas, Texas over COVID-19. We filed it in March 2020 against the Chinese Communist Party and its Wuhan lab, seeking trillions in damages for a nationwide class of victims, and that class could include you. I am now amending that complaint to add Anthony Fauci as a defendant, along with former so-called President Joe Biden, to invalidate the phony and illegal pardon that the Biden Crime Family slipped him in the dead of night. That question could go all the way to the Supreme Court, and this case may be the only vehicle to take it there. "But didn't Biden pardon him?" A pardon is no defense to a civil lawsuit. It stops a prosecutor, and nothing more. It cannot stop a jury from ordering Fauci to pay damages for what he did. In my courtroom that pardon is a worthless scrap of paper. And that midnight pardon has a problem of its own. The House Oversight Committee found that Biden's last-minute pardons were signed by autopen — by a machine — with no proof that Biden even knew about them, and declared them null and void. The Supreme Court said more than a century ago that accepting a pardon carries "a confession" of guilt. So we will ask the court to strike that pardon down, and we will go after Joe Biden for issuing it. Better still, a jury in a civil case is allowed by binding Supreme Court precedent to hold a defendant's silence against him as evidence that he is liable. He handed us Exhibit A, 111 times over. Senator Paul says he will hold a contempt vote, and God bless him for trying. But you and I both know exactly how that ends: the filibuster will kill it, and official Washington will protect its own. The Senate has not successfully held anyone in contempt since 1971. That is why Freedom Watch exists. We are your real Justice Department — because the one in Washington has been inert, and the Senate is a debating society with a coat check. Congressional hearings produce headlines and press releases, while federal lawsuits produce subpoenas, sworn testimony, documentary evidence and enforceable judgments. Missouri already won a $24 billion judgment against China over COVID and is moving to seize Chinese assets to collect it, so do not tell me this cannot be done. But a fight of this size is WAR , and war costs money. Freedom Watch is a 501(c)(3), your gift is tax-deductible, and every dollar goes straight into this case. You gave them two years, and they never asked. I am asking. Give me one gift, and I will haul these people into court and get you the answers they owe you. In Justice,Larry Klayman Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch Chairman and General Counsel, Freedom Watch, Inc. P.S. **You lost a business, a funeral, a church, or two years of your child's life — and he took the Fifth 111 times rather than tell you why. In civil court, that silence can be used against him. We file within weeks, and I want your name standing with mine when we do. | | | | |

The Guardian reported that the administration canceled millions of dollars in grants meant to study long-term brain health, including research at Emory University right here in Georgia. As a microbiologist, I need you to understand how reckless this is. Research does not happen overnight. Scientists spend years building studies, collecting data, following evidence, and asking hard questions about why people get sick and how we can help them. **And Trump and RFK Jr. are willing to blow that up because they saw words they did not like.** Alzheimer’s and dementia already touch millions of families. They steal names, memories, independence, and time. Every family that has watched someone they love slip away knows we need more science, not less. But instead of funding the work, this administration is cutting it. Instead of listening to experts, they are targeting them. Instead of protecting public health, they are turning it into a culture war. **I am running for Congress because science needs backup. Families need leaders who understand that research is not some luxury item — it is how we find answers, save lives, and protect the people we love.** **[Will you make a donation today to help me fight back against Trump and RFK Jr.’s attacks on science and public health?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137651145/641497005/-12840034?refcode=260821-alzheimers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NjYwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YTMyOTlkNC02YjlkLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qqjm5WqxCMnMtAUNihmdGges8613R7D_Uj-Son_tuu8=)**

Scientists spend years building studies, collecting data, following evidence, and asking hard questions about why people get sick and how we can help them. And Trump and RFK Jr. are willing to blow that up because they saw words they did not like. Alzheimer’s and dementia already touch millions of families. They steal names, memories, independence, and time. Every family that has watched someone they love slip away knows we need more science, not less. But instead of funding the work, this administration is cutting it. Instead of listening to experts, they are targeting them. Instead of protecting public health, they are turning it into a culture war. I am running for Congress because science needs backup. Families need leaders who understand that research is not some luxury item — it is how we find answers, save lives, and protect the people we love. = = They can try to cut the funding.They can try to silence the experts. But they will not stop us from fighting for facts, families, and the future. Folks, when the Vice President came to NC to attack me by name, I knew we were in for a long race.
When President Trump followed up a few weeks later with a late-night Truth Social post attacking me again, I knew they were nervous.
Now, after President Trump's attack dog Stephen Miller went on Fox News to rant and rave about me, I can tell we're getting to them.
There are a lot of important Senate races happening this year, but President Trump knows that if they just win in NC, it'll stop our chances of taking back the Senate. Republicans will likely keep Senate control until 2029.
That's why we're facing these nonstop attacks, and why I'm writing to you today. If we can't hit our fundraising goals, it'll make it much harder to run the ads we need to win - and this is a race we just can't afford to lose.

---
Hi friend,
I’ve worked across the world helping patients survive combat and disaster zones, both as a combat trauma surgeon and as a volunteer surgeon. But my experience in Gaza in 2024 is at the very core of why I’m running for Congress.
I treated children pulled from rubble and people who survived bombings, only for the majority of them to die within 48 hours due to malnutrition and a lack of medical supplies—an intentional act of genocide funded by our tax dollars. I still struggle to process what I witnessed. And I saw our leaders in Washington deploy military resources in Gaza, Venezuela, and Iran—while telling us we don’t have the money to take care of our communities here at home.
It’s this hypocrisy that made me want to run for Congress. Our government is spending _our_ tax dollars to fund these atrocities and enable genocides, while Americans are dying without healthcare, getting price-gouged at the grocery store, and struggling with the rising gas prices.
None of this is accidental. It’s the result of leaders who are voting without consequence, captured by elite interests, and making decisions in their own self-interest instead of yours.
**And in June, voters right here in NJ-12 sent a message of their own.**
Despite racist smear efforts, our grassroots campaign won the Democratic primary for New Jersey's 12th Congressional District. That victory showed something important: people are tired of politics that serves powerful interests while everyday families and vulnerable communities are left behind.
But challenging the status quo is never easy. The interests that benefit from our broken system aren't going away, and neither are the obstacles standing in the way of real change.
**We need champions of peace and justice in Congress. I intend to be one of them.**

#

Friends, can I show you something?
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260821-1-b&t=1&akid=11750%2E3935704%2E9LWYVE)
This is a replica of my skull after being shot in the head. I was at a constituent event when I was the target of a politically motivated shooting. The gunman killed six people and wounded 12 others.
The doctors made a replica of my skull to create the titanium plate that was used to replace the part of my skull that had to be removed due to swelling. I keep it to remind myself of what I survived on that awful day in January 2011.
It’s been fifteen years since my shooting, but not a week goes by when I don’t think about it. Some days are harder than ever, but I never stop fighting.
I see our fight to end gun violence the same way. There have been setbacks, but we can never lose sight of our work to save lives from the gun violence epidemic.
**But too many politicians have shown that they’d rather cave to the gun lobby than fight for our families. As I write this, Donald Trump and his allies are working to roll back our progress and hand massive wins for their gun CEO buddies. Enough is enough.**
Everything is at stake in the midterm elections. I am working to rally voters and elect gun safety champions across the country, but the only way we can continue sharing our message is with your support.
So with less than 100 days until the election, I am personally asking: [**Will you pitch in $10 or more to help GIFFORDS PAC elect leaders in the most competitive of races and power our work to end gun violence?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/65324?c0=giff-em-q32026.dTscjt&refcode=em260821-1-b&t=2&akid=11750%2E3935704%2E9LWYVE)

name: Americans for Responsible Innovation
subject: You're Invited: Virtual Panel on Who Sets Data Center Terms
body:
September 9: the Republicans and Democrats writing the rules for data center deals in Ohio, New York, and Georgia, on what communities can demand.

| | Virtual Panel |
---|---
# You're Invited: Data Center Community Advocates Share Their Stories
Community stewardship in the data center era
Across the country, residents are demanding a voice in negotiations for data center deals that impact their communities. Some voters have passed guardrails protecting against rising energy demand, some have demanded a moratorium, and some have secured local investment in education and workforce training.

**On September 9, hear from state and local leaders who have secured guardrails in their community.** State lawmakers, county officials and advocates will share their success stories advocating for agreements that mandate transparency and benefit their communities.
|
---
Construction is accelerating. In most places, the terms are not public.
| Tuesday, September 9
2:00 PM ET, online | | [Register](https://us.list-manage.com/TB6nm2S7DIc?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)
---
What we'll explore | What have communities actually secured from developers and hyperscalers, and which of those wins can be replicated?
---
Where do negotiations break down, and what do siting trackers and energy reporting change at the bargaining table?
What should residents be entitled to when a data center comes to town?
Panelists | Ohio Rep. Adam Holmes Chair, House Energy Committee | New York Sen. Kristen Gonzalez Chair, Internet & Technology Committee | Georgia Comm. Peter Hubbard Georgia Public Service Commission
---|---|---
| Moderator Jessica Maksimov Americans for Responsible Innovation

The panel opens with brief introductions, followed by a moderated discussion and audience Q&A. The session is recorded and shared with everyone who registers. | [Register for September 9](https://us.list-manage.com/uuCuP3peVCg?e=a07d75591f&c2id=4fb88adb36cbae4881a2e5f253eb58cf)

name: Tim Burchett
subject: The briefing was classified. My anger is not.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress
body:
Bureaucrats dodge. Insiders protect insiders. But I keep digging.

| [](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._fHpA)
---
Recently, I walked into another classified briefing.
As a Member of Congress, that is part of my job. And there are things discussed in those rooms that I simply cannot repeat.
Some information must remain classified to protect our country, our service members, and our intelligence operations.
But here is what I can tell you: [The American people deserve leaders who ask hard questions, not politicians who nod along, memorize the approved talking points, and shuffle back out the door.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
Whether it is government waste, border security, taxpayer dollars winding up in the wrong hands, or information the bureaucracy would rather keep buried, Congress has a duty to demand answers.
Too often, Washington’s response boils down to: [“Don’t worry about it.”](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
Well, I do worry about it.
I worry because I work for the people who sent me here, not the corrupt insiders, unelected bureaucrats, or sewer rats scurrying around Washington.
There are plenty of folks in this town who would be tickled pink if Members of Congress stopped asking questions, kept their mouths shut, and left the establishment alone.
I am not one of them.
I did not come to Washington to sit quietly while bureaucrats dodge questions, insiders protect one another, and taxpayers get stuck with the bill.
I came here to raise Cain, demand answers, and make the DC cartel mighty uncomfortable.
[Peter, will you chip in whatever you can swing today to help me keep after them?](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)

| Hello Republican Friends,
As Massachusetts Republicans, we approach September 1st with a shared responsibility: to participate fully in our primary and then to come together as one party.
The primary is the moment we choose our nominees. The days that follow are the moment we choose unity. Whatever the outcome, our strength will be measured not by the contests behind us, but by the discipline, purpose, and respect we bring to the work ahead.
We encourage every Republican to vote, to honor the process, and to look forward to November, together.
In Unity, Leanne Harris Chair, MassGOP Public Relations Committee State Committeewoman, Middlesex & Norfolk District X @LeanneHarrisMA [leannejharris@gmail.com](mailto:leannejharris@gmail.com)

Young Republican Spotlight: Kevin Broderick
---
|
---
Kevin is a 21 yr old Senior at Stonehill College who grew up in Norwood MA. He is majoring in Political Science & International Relations with a minor concentration in Public Administration & Public Policy.
Kevin has been an intern at Norwood Town Hall in the General Manager's office since 2022. He is active in his community as a Town Meeting member & volunteer for
* Norwood Rotary Club,
* Neponset Valley Sunrise Rotary Club,
* Concert Committee, &
* 4th of July Committee as parade coordinator

He admires the genuine nature of Representative Marcus Vaughn who is able to get stuff done for his community while staying true to traditional conservative values. Kevin believes Republican candidates would increase their electability by modeling their campaigns in a similar fashion to Rep Vaughn.
Kevin is currently the Norwood RTC Chair & newly elected Norfolk County Republican Committee Vice Chair
Kevin's goal in these roles is to refine the roles & responsibilities of Republican organizations within Norfolk County; to encourage these groups to work collaboratively in order to successfully elect candidates at all levels of government
Kevin became interested in politics at age 13 after listening to Conservative Commentary on social media.
He now has his own Youtube show called " The Kevin Broderick Show" where he interviews local and statewide politicians and government officials. Interviews with John Deaton, Michael Walsh, and Elizabeth Dionne will be coming

In August 2026, Tyson Foods announced it is permanently closing its beef processing facility in Joslin, Illinois, and its case-ready operation in Eagle Mountain, Utah, while also pursuing the sale of its plant in Pasco, Washington. More than 3,000 workers will lose their jobs--over 2,500 at the Joslin facility alone, which had the capacity to process roughly 3,000 head of cattle per day.
Why Tyson Says It's Happening
Tyson's stated rationale is straightforward: "one of the most historic cattle shortages the country has ever experienced." The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to its lowest level in roughly 75 years, driven by years of drought that forced ranchers to liquidate herds, combined with high feed costs and rising interest rates that made it expensive to retain and rebuild breeding stock.

More than 3,000 workers will lose their jobs--over 2,500 at the Joslin facility alone, which had the capacity to process roughly 3,000 head of cattle per day. Why Tyson Says It's Happening Tyson's stated rationale is straightforward: "one of the most historic cattle shortages the country has ever experienced." The U.S. cattle herd has shrunk to its lowest level in roughly 75 years, driven by years of drought that forced ranchers to liquidate herds, combined with high feed costs and rising interest rates that made it expensive to retain and rebuild breeding stock. | | ---|---|--- Continue reading this post for free in the Substack app | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Heartland Journal 99 E. name: Oregon Department of Justice
subject: Safeguarding elections, blocking corporate mergers, and more from Oregon DOJ
body:
Plus town halls in Pendleton, East PDX, and Hood River
---
| | | |
---
|
# Oregon DOJ is fighting for Oregonians every day.
From challenging unlawful mergers and monopolies, to taking action to protect our environment, to hosting town halls across the state to hear from you, the staff and attorneys at the Oregon Department of Justice are working tirelessly every day to serve Oregonians. Read on for more about our work:
* Keeping costs down
* Safeguarding our elections
* Protecting our environment
* Hearing from you at upcoming town halls in Pendleton, East Portland, and Hood River
* And more!

You are always welcome to contact our office with questions or feedback. We value every email, letter, and phone call. Thank you, Dan Rayfield, Oregon Attorney General
---
| |
* * *
---
# How we're blocking unlawful corporate mergers that drive up costs
[](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Fagdanrayfield.bsky.social%2Fpost%2F3moj3ojlktk2c/1/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/a-QAxYHJtVUUZ_t8zetOADqQWK8DFC1wkXRisent-JY=452) | | We've had several big wins recently in our work challenging monopolies and corporate mergers that mean higher prices and fewer choices for Oregonians. After we stepped in, **Paramount & Warner Bros. agreed to [pause](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-paramount-agrees-to-delay-warner-bros-merger-pending-trial%2F/1/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/fzYdwTWhLPU6TgLQRTe4anTYcp-wDTXO6MJMoL5V8Us=452) their $110 billion mega-merger. **This is a huge win for Oregonians, and especially for our thriving film industry. We also **won a court order against Nexstar** (which owns KOIN in Portland) for ["brazenly" violating the order pausing its merger with Tegna](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-wins-federal-court-decision-over-nexstar-violating-merger-order%2F/1/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/TZfHp_Cd59xWeBE0B5jHtvKR9pUEnYMSo0a2u1jnz-k=452) (which owns KGW). And in June, we got approval for [16 new positions to investigate and fight corporate mergers and monopolies](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.doj.state.or.us%2Fmedia-home%2Fnews-media-releases%2Fag-rayfield-secures-approval-for-16-new-positions-to-fight-mergers-monopolies%2F/1/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/gj-EugOKw6negcF0FH1N93WqU0CUVKOlCsb_f9lUkrA=452) that are driving up costs. **We will continue to step in to fill the gap in antitrust enforcement as the federal government steps back.**
---|---|---
| |
* * *
---
# Protecting elections and vote-by-mail
We want Oregonians across the state to be confident that **Oregon DOJ is working around the clock to protect mail-in voting and Oregonians’ right to vote.** Right now, we're waiting on a procedural ruling from the Supreme Court that could impact vote-by-mail – _but_ the important thing to know is that, no matter what they decide, we'll continue the legal fight to protect Oregon's elections. [Learn more.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2FBVYlP4of4y4/1/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/Dba9HcJpyfvgfBh8YrKkoSVtHvQzqzYSvHbPUl8CRMY=452) **We're working with state and local leaders to ensure we have safe and smooth elections this November and beyond.** | | [](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2FBVYlP4of4y4/2/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/rShHVSGzRmOZ2f2J9LyZXFf4CmnGxLofN5hNmcLyoMQ=452)
---|---|---
| |
* * *
---
# Clean air, clean water, and protecting our environment
[](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2FYF-nYqrFE2g/1/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/P_3w22spL5vrs1LIydWoEAX8PV8bCY3rwy1zCaA-jYA=452) | | **We’re fighting to defend environmental protections, because a big part of keeping communities safe is making sure Oregonians have clean air to breathe, and clean water to drink.** When the Trump administration tries to roll back environmental protections, we fight back to stop them. We've opposed plans to weaken the Clean Air Act, delay vehicle emissions standards, and more. And we've won: we recently got a court ruling upholding strong environmental protections for soot – a huge win for kids with asthma, older adults with health issues, and all Oregonians. [Learn more.](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2FYF-nYqrFE2g/2/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/98OpV6AjLz72E7iRb7CHiATWN5lXN0CLArcn4ibyIg0=452)
---|---|---
| |
* * *
---
# Our 70+ lawsuits are keeping costs down and protecting $6.9 billion
We recently filed our 75th lawsuit against the Trump administration. Through these lawsuits, we have safeguarded about $6,900,000,000 in federal funds coming into Oregon.

These dollars fund things like food assistance, disaster recovery, public health grants, programs supporting victims of crime, and much more – programs impacting lives across our state. [Listen to our reflections on filing our 70th lawsuit](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2FJZkdRC0-sHg/1/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/XSPCMW-TZhsbhMemvej1SAgijfCfU0_i3XaMbt0h1o0=452) against the Trump administration. [Learn more about the $6.9 billion we've safeguarded](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2F71crpCVQeYw/1/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/D1UsU_oc_ZStyWJLId952KlTeW-eWrGH9zjfEgZuDB0=452) for Oregon to date. | | [](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fshorts%2FJZkdRC0-sHg/2/010101a024e03b4f-b7e17cd0-06df-4213-88e2-31d4a5c507d9-000000/3wpWmURqMnYIagmz6YzWX6W6vMMeNmUlhIm_OM1TsyE=452)
---|---|---
* * *
---

Kayse Jama, State Rep. Andrea Valderrama, and State Rep. Read on for more about our work: Keeping costs down Safeguarding our elections Protecting our environment Hearing from you at upcoming town halls in Pendleton, East Portland, and Hood River And more! After we stepped in, Paramount & Warner Bros. agreed to their $110 billion mega-merger. This is a huge win for Oregonians, and especially for our thriving film industry. We also won a court order against Nexstar (which owns KOIN in Portland) for (which owns KGW). And in June, we got approval for that are driving up costs. We will continue to step in to fill the gap in antitrust enforcement as the federal government steps back. ---|---|--- | | Protecting elections and vote-by-mail We want Oregonians across the state to be confident that Oregon DOJ is working around the clock to protect mail-in voting and Oregonians’ right to vote. Right now, we're waiting on a procedural ruling from the Supreme Court that could impact vote-by-mail – but the important thing to know is that, no matter what they decide, we'll continue the legal fight to protect Oregon's elections. We're working with state and local leaders to ensure we have safe and smooth elections this November and beyond. | | ---|---|--- | | Clean air, clean water, and protecting our environment | | We’re fighting to defend environmental protections, because a big part of keeping communities safe is making sure Oregonians have clean air to breathe, and clean water to drink. When the Trump administration tries to roll back environmental protections, we fight back to stop them. We've opposed plans to weaken the Clean Air Act, delay vehicle emissions standards, and more. And we've won: we recently got a court ruling upholding strong environmental protections for soot – a huge win for kids with asthma, older adults with health issues, and all Oregonians. ---|---|--- | | Our 70+ lawsuits are keeping costs down and protecting $6.9 billion We recently filed our 75th lawsuit against the Trump administration. name: BREAKTHROUGH HOUR with Sean Feucht
subject: The attack on families is REAL
body:
Episode 17 now available!| | |
---
| |
---
This week's Breakthrough Hour is about one of the key attacks for the age — the attack on the family. Family is God's design, and Satan wants to undermine and erode that design. In this episode, Kate and I give insight into how we disciple our kids in a culture working against them — from praying over them before school and turning car rides into pastoring moments, to walking through injury and loss, protecting our kids from bitterness and offense, and a full-circle worship moment back at the beach where we met as teenagers — plus a huge update on the first water wells we've broken ground on in rural India. Despite the attacks on families, we have seen God moving, especially among the next generation!
---

Each week on Breakthrough Hour, we will shine a spotlight on what God is doing right now across nations, cultures, and communities!

name: Marc Elias
subject: My update on Trump's latest attack in NH
body:
Hi there, it's
Marc Elias.

I’ll get right to the point: We have less than 75 days until the midterm
elections, [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260821_1.fG9_Z-&refcode=em20260821-1&t=1001&akid=8438%2E582294%2EDSe5MU ]and I’m asking you to split a donation of $5
between Chris Pappas’s campaign and the DSCC to help flip the Senate blue.

Here is why your support right now is so critical:

* Republicans view New Hampshire as one of their best opportunities to
flip a Senate seat.
* GOP super PACs and dark money groups are pledging millions to back
Chris’s opponent John Sununu and move the Granite State backward.
* MAGA billionaires are determined to buy this open Senate seat and
notch another rubber stamp for Donald Trump’s reckless agenda.

We just won a massive victory in court striking down New Hampshire's
unconstitutional HB 1569 voter suppression law – but now Trump’s DOJ is
deploying federal "election monitors" directly into Manchester and Nashua,
demanding access to private state voter records, and threatening local
election officials.

Make no mistake: This isn’t about election integrity. It’s a coordinated
strategy to intimidate voters and tilt the midterms in the GOP’s favor.

I spend my days fighting these unconstitutional attacks in court, but
litigation alone won't protect this seat. We need a pro-democracy firewall
in the Senate, and that starts with electing Chris Pappas.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260821_1.fG9_Z-&refcode=em20260821-1&t=1002&akid=8438%2E582294%2EDSe5MU ]Before our crucial fundraising deadline, will you split
$5 or more between Chris Pappas and the DSCC to elect
candidates who will fight back against voter suppression and help flip the
Senate blue?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260821_1.fG9_Z-&amount=5&refcode=em20260821-1&t=1021&akid=8438%2E582294%2EDSe5MU ]Donate $5 »

The GOP is counting on exhaustion and resignation to win this election. We
cannot – and will not – give them either.

Thank you for standing up for our democracy,

Marc Elias

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137660820/641524086/1239926708?refcode=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ms=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3N2E3Y2E0My03NzlkLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kisIz7VtVvQJs-Dop0vw2Wdd_GdQgG00rfzL0xh_Ho=&emci=711be334-c59c-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=51844520) Friends, when I clerked for Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg, she taught me through her words and actions about advocating for others. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137660821/641524111/-538647644?refcode=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ms=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3N2E3Y2E0My03NzlkLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kisIz7VtVvQJs-Dop0vw2Wdd_GdQgG00rfzL0xh_Ho=)
Me with Justice Ginsburg in 1995. (Not pictured: the white gloves she liked to wear!) Justice Ginsburg inspired me to always fight injustice, stand up for our freedoms, and promote equality and justice for all. And as we face unprecedented threats to these values, I think often of how she would respond to them and how she would want me to. **[Justice Ginsburg taught us to fight for what we believe in — and do it in a way that others will join us. That’s my mission as I run to be your next governor. And I’m humbly asking for your support so we have the resources to stay on track toward our fundraising goals and win in November.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137660822/641524112/2125756875?refcode=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ms=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3N2E3Y2E0My03NzlkLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kisIz7VtVvQJs-Dop0vw2Wdd_GdQgG00rfzL0xh_Ho=)** | | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137660823/641524113/2125756875?refcode=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ms=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3N2E3Y2E0My03NzlkLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kisIz7VtVvQJs-Dop0vw2Wdd_GdQgG00rfzL0xh_Ho=)

When there is a debate at the Supreme Court on “if you're born here in the US, are you really a citizen?”, I know Justice Ginsburg would fight passionately against this attempt to claw back the 14th Amendment protections our nation established over a century ago.
**I will always fight back against lawless attempts to strip Americans of their citizenship.**
When _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned back in 2022 with the Supreme Court’s _Dobbs_ decision, I recalled my mentor and knew how appalled Justice Ginsburg would have been.
**I will always defend Coloradans’ right to abortion access and reproductive freedom.**
When the Supreme Court stands by its atrocious _Citizens United_ decision, which RBG called the Court’s worst recent decision, I know that we cannot just wait idly by.
**I will always fight for a political system that represents people, not corporations and the wealthy few — and that’s why I am championing a proposal to prevent corporations from donating to Colorado campaigns.**
And when we witness the Bully-in-Chief violating the rule of law in so many other ways — whether he’s coming after Colorado for our gold-standard election system, bypassing Congress to set tariffs that cause chaos for Colorado businesses and families, or sending ICE to spread terror in our communities — I know RBG would demand that we rise to the occasion. **I will never give in to this administration’s lawless bullying without putting up a fight.**
**[Justice Ginsburg taught me valuable lessons about using the law to stand up and deliver for all people. As your next governor, I will put those lessons into action. And to win in November, I need your support today. If you’re able, can you chip in $25 to help keep us on track?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137660824/641524114/2125756875?amount=25&refcode=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ms=ea.77a7ca43-779d-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3N2E3Y2E0My03NzlkLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kisIz7VtVvQJs-Dop0vw2Wdd_GdQgG00rfzL0xh_Ho=)**

# Palestine
* **15-year-old boy dies after being shot in the head by Israel in Gaza:** A 15-year-old Palestinian boy died on Thursday after being shot by Israeli troops in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza. Footage appears to show him shot in the head.
* **Israeli forces and settlers kill two Palestinians, wound several others in occupied West Bank attacks:**
* **Hebron:** A 17-year-old Palestinian boy was [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/641c214e-23f1-420c-a0b6-6cf1040fffde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after being shot in the chest by armed Israeli settlers during an attack on homes in Khirbet Hamroush, northeast of Hebron, WAFA reported. A 70-year-old man was also shot and wounded, and settlers burned down a home. In southern Hebron, settlers [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/d43b6a27-180b-49ce-b97f-a09edfc71540?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) homes near Al-Dhahiriya and Al-Samu, injuring five Palestinians, stealing sheep and attacking a Palestinian Red Crescent ambulance, preventing it from reaching the wounded. Israeli forces later arrested four Palestinians in Shaab Al-Butum, including a father and son, and three others during a raid on Beit Ummar.
* **Jenin:** Israeli forces [shot and killed](https://substack.com/redirect/5f538898-3aaf-4306-8cc5-a06091b5df96?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Fathi Hazem, a 58-year-old retired police colonel in the Palestinian National Security Forces, during a raid on his home in central Jenin and withheld his body. An eyewitness told AFP, "They shot him seven times in front of his 10-year-old son. They dragged him down the stairs and took him with them." Two of Hazem's other sons were killed by the Israeli military in 2022. In Zababdeh, south of Jenin, Israeli forces shot a 14-year-old boy in the chest and back during a raid. Israeli forces also hung Israeli flags along several points of the Jenin-Nablus road.
* **Nablus:** Israeli settlers attacked the Bula Al-Hawa area, east of Nablus, [beating](https://substack.com/redirect/0f3555b7-bab2-4c4f-8ac9-71a61379f2e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a Palestinian.
* **Drop Site reports on detained Palestinian journalist:** After more than two years in Israeli detention, the first photo of Palestinian journalist Mohammed Arab emerged on Monday. Israeli forces seized Arab from Gaza's Al-Shifa Medical Complex on March 18, 2024.
* "They are calling on us using the quadcopters. Pray for me, and take care of the children," Arab told his wife Wafaa Abu Al-Laban in their final conversation.
* "Mohammed's health is very, very poor," Abu Al-Laban told Drop Site's Abdel Qader Sabbah. Arab was subjected to severe abuse at Sde Teiman and forced to remain on his knees for prolonged periods, causing a slipped disc and serious back problems. His eyesight also deteriorated after his glasses were taken away, his lawyer said.
* After more than two years in detention, Arab told his lawyer that seeing his own face had become a dream. "I just want to know what I look like," he said. A petition had to be filed to obtain underwear and a mirror for him.
* **Watch Abdel Qader Sabbah 's video report on Mohamed Arab for Drop Site [here](https://substack.com/redirect/dbe16177-1bda-4aa0-b574-3a5d77db3329?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**

* **Hamas is "fully committed" to Board of Peace roadmap, official says:** Basem Naim, a senior Hamas official, [told](https://substack.com/redirect/70e2ed56-0dd1-4c5c-95b5-0ee837a094eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) CNN on Thursday that the group remains fully committed to the "agreed version" of the "Board of Peace" roadmap for Gaza, noting that the group believes that the roadmap satisfactorily handles the decommissioning of its weapons, the future of its tunnels, and implementation timelines.
* President Donald Trump's envoy Nickolay Mladenov had pledged to secure Israel's approval for the deal, Naim said, but Israel has since rejected the deal and carried out massacres in Gaza in a deliberate attempt to derail it.
* Naim also [told](https://substack.com/redirect/5328b378-da52-4f46-8dcc-04600c9922de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) CNN that Board of Peace mediators and Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner are asking Hamas to be "sensitive" to Benjamin Netanyahu's political position ahead of Israel's upcoming election over the already-agreed Gaza roadmap. "As a Palestinian, I am not in a position to pay the price from the bodies and blood and the lives of our people in order to secure the victory of Netanyahu's election," Naim noted to CNN in response.
* **Qatar, Turkey, and Egypt condemn Israeli attacks on Gaza:** Qatar, Egypt, and Turkey "strongly [condemned](https://substack.com/redirect/a5bcef8f-73ff-459c-888e-5d7af8343bad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" recent Israeli attacks on Gaza that have killed civilians, including women and children, in a joint statement Wednesday.
* The statement said the intensification of Israeli attacks "undermines regional and international efforts at a critical juncture," as work continues to implement the plan to end the war, including the Board of Peace's meeting with Israeli officials. They stressed that Israel must "fully comply with all its obligations under the ceasefire agreement" and refrain from actions that could escalate tensions.
* **European leaders condemn Israeli settlement expansion:** The leaders of the UK, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway and Canada [condemned](https://substack.com/redirect/b9b8f896-4ff6-4c70-9ac4-21aeb938584c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Israel's decision to issue construction tenders for the E1 settlement project in the occupied West Bank in a joint statement on Thursday.
* The statement urges Israel to "retract these plans immediately" and halt settlement expansion.
* It also warns businesses not to bid on the tenders, citing possible "legal and reputational consequences" and the risk of involvement in "serious breaches of international law."
* **Turkey seeks Interpol red notice for Netanyahu over Global Sumud Flotilla attack:** Turkey [asked](https://substack.com/redirect/71044dae-2df6-49e7-83f7-400fe3140e59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Interpol to issue a red notice for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over the Israeli attack on activists aboard the Global Sumud Flotilla carrying humanitarian aid to Gaza, Justice Minister Akin Gurlek said Friday via Anadolu Agency. Gurlek said proceedings are continuing before an Istanbul court against 35 defendants over the attack in international waters and the detention of activists.
* Arrest warrants were issued for Netanyahu and Israeli official Afek Moskovitch on July 14 on charges including genocide, crimes against humanity, torture, aggravated deprivation of liberty and hijacking, prompting the Justice Ministry to request Interpol red notices.
* **Three Palestinian parties in Israel revive Joint List ahead of October Knesset election** : Three Palestinian parties in Israel, Hadash, Balad, and Ta'al, [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/16b5e857-5cf7-41f6-8f5b-dc7345c05091?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a reconstituted Joint List on Wednesday ahead of the October 27 Knesset election.
* The list will be led by Hadash's Yousef Jabareen, followed by Ta'al's Ahmad Tibi and Balad's Sami Abu Shehadeh, with the parties targeting at least 10 seats and competing against the United Arab List led by Mansour Abbas.
* Balad deputy secretary-general Yousef Tatur said the party made concessions to reach the agreement given "the gravity of the current moment," citing Israel's genocide in Gaza, West Bank displacement, and attacks in Jerusalem, and called on Palestinian voters with Israeli citizenship who are eligible to vote to help "turn unity into a real force on the ground."

# Iran
* **U.S. threatens countries trading with Iran with "economic oblivion"**: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent [said](https://substack.com/redirect/5c9db71c-2cd5-4581-8fc0-3ce88a975907?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Thursday that Washington would impose the "toughest sanctions in history" on Iran following Trump's declaration of "economic warfare."
* "The economic pressure means that we are going to all of our allies, and this is going to be the greatest coordinated economic isolation in the history of the world," Bessent told CNBC, noting that all countries will now be judged as "either with us or against" the U.S. based on their economic relationship with Iran.
* "If you insist on doing business with them, either transferring money or buying their oil, they are doing seaborne ship transfers, then the US Treasury and the U.S. government, they will put its full might and force toward enforcing against you," Bessent told CNBC.
* Separately, Bessent [noted](https://substack.com/redirect/55e9aa57-2c94-4a98-9a50-70e54d664a8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his confusion at rising oil prices, saying that the U.S. had "asymmetric information" and he was "not sure why oil has popped up on this."
* Vice President JD Vance said Thursday that the war with Iran had entered "a new phase where the most effective tool we have is the economic pressure we can impose on them." "It will be a delicate dance," he added, because Iran "will try to put economic pressure on us."
* Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf called for a plan to overcome what he described as "cruel sanctions" following the U.S. Treasury announcement. Speaking during a visit to Iraq, Ghalibaf said Iran and other Muslim countries possess significant resources and raw materials that their "enemies are coming to plunder," and urged Baghdad to cooperate with Tehran in confronting the sanctions.
* **China registers opposition to U.S. economic campaign against Iran:** Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian [said](https://substack.com/redirect/d1a6a661-2fa7-4daa-a90c-04260e3b9c80?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Friday that the newest round of U.S. economic pressure would "not help to resolve" the conflict in the Middle East.
* Lin called on all sides to address tensions through political and diplomatic means.
* China has repeatedly rejected unilateral U.S. sanctions, arguing that measures not authorized by the UN Security Council lack standing in international law.

* **Oil traffic through Hormuz remains constrained:** Kpler [recorded](https://substack.com/redirect/4fe19c63-24da-4a40-b22b-aa3cab524d21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 10.73 million barrels of west-to-east liquid tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz from August 14-20, an average of just 1.53 million barrels per day, a sharp contrast from the 10 million barrels per day figure that two U.S. officials gave Axios.
* Only 14 outbound tankers were observed during the entire week, with no recorded traffic on August 14 or 17, according to the maritime tracking firm.
* Kpler cautions that its figures may change as more vessel-position data becomes available, including from ships traveling with their tracking systems switched off. But the currently observed traffic is nowhere near the scale Washington described.
* **Iranian crude oil offers to Chinese buyers decline:** Offers of Iranian crude to Chinese buyers have fallen this week, Reuters [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/3d0636b8-4f8e-42b8-852a-ca82a16e346b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Friday, while prices have jumped.
* The number of planned deliveries for September and October declined from July and August, and barrels shipped earlier have already been sold.
* Crude oil, which is usually sold at a lower price, is now being sold at premiums, Reuters reported.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli army continues attacks in Lebanon despite "ceasefire" agreement: **Israeli forces [set off](https://substack.com/redirect/9c5ad8ce-4047-4a2a-a3b0-a9f707d7b09e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a "massive explosion," conducted in two stages, in the area between the towns of Arnoun and Kfar Tebnit, in the Nabatieh district in southern Lebanon, the Lebanese National News Agency reported on Friday.
* In Tyre (Sour), Israeli attacks were [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/5e57a023-18db-4ec1-bbe9-9c03d91d8fe9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Mansouri-Majdal Zoun area, according to the NNA, with the Israeli military firing artillery shells on Mansouri.
* Israeli soldiers also fired on Khiam, where Israeli forces had blown up a house. Israeli warplanes also struck the outskirts of Baraashit, in the Bint Jbeil district, targeting a house, early Friday morning.
* Israeli forces bombarded the strategic Ali Taher hill in southern Lebanon for more than five hours overnight, with artillery fire beginning after 11 p.m. and continuing until around 5 a.m., L'Orient Today reported.
* **Explosions heard over Tyre as PM Salam tells army its deployment restores state "sovereignty, authority and prestige": **Explosions were heard over the southern Lebanese city of Tyre (Sour) on Friday as Prime Minister Nawaf Salam [delivered](https://substack.com/redirect/bdc91128-4a94-4e49-ae15-8db6bb678b3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a speech at the Benoit Barakat Barracks, Lebanon's National News Agency reported. Speaking as Israeli attacks on Lebanon continue, Salam said restoring sovereignty requires "one strong army" and bringing all of southern Lebanon under the authority of the state. He said the Lebanese state and its constitutional institutions must regain the "decision of war and peace," describing the army's deployment in the south as the restoration of state "sovereignty, authority and prestige."
* **U.S. issues sanctions on Hezbollah:** The U.S. Treasury Department [sanctioned](https://substack.com/redirect/555180d4-4e5e-401b-af15-a546b8865a7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 10 people it says form a network smuggling cash to Hezbollah, and redesignated Hezbollah itself as operating "under the command" of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps-Quds Force (IRGC-QF), OFAC announced Thursday.
* The Treasury Department accused the network of using couriers on commercial flights between Lebanon, Turkey, the UAE, and Iran to move "up to hundreds of millions of dollars," giving Hezbollah a channel outside the banking system to obtain foreign currency and evade sanctions.
* A State Department official said the redesignation is meant to show Hezbollah is "not a stand-alone operation" but acts for Iran.
* Hezbollah [responded](https://substack.com/redirect/9f809846-8f98-4890-9a40-911ed20a4b76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the sanctions on Friday morning, rejecting its characterization as "under the command" of the IRGC, adding it did not need anyone to certify its Lebanese identity or patriotism, and describing its relationship with Iran as a "close and fraternal" relationship.
* It described the move as part of longstanding U.S. policies aimed at targeting Hezbollah through political, financial, and security pressure, which it said was intended to "protect the security of the Israeli enemy," and said the sanctions would "not deter" its fight against Israel.

# U.S. News
* **Progressive Aisha Wahab wins California special election, dealing blow to AIPAC-backed opponent** : State Senator **Aisha Wahab** [defeated](https://substack.com/redirect/b6aa1eb4-8872-40c8-8647-711355e382a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) transit official **Melissa Hernandez** in the special election to fill former Representative **Eric Swalwell 's **House seat, despite Hernandez's backing from the American Israel Public Affairs Committee's super PAC, United Democracy Project, which spent roughly $2.5 million in the race.
* Wahab, who opposes unconditional aid to Israel and has characterized Israel's conduct in Gaza as a "genocide," will represent the district for the remainder of the year.
* **Emails reveal ICE quietly coordinated with Iran on deportation flights** : Newly released emails obtained by the National Iranian American Council show U.S. immigration officials worked with Iranian government representatives to deport more than 100 Iranians on three flights between September 2025 and January 2026, with Iranian officials influencing which individuals were included on deportation manifests and ICE at times heeding last-minute requests from the Iranian Embassy, according to CBS News.
* The coordination continued even during the June 2025 U.S.-Israel war with Iran. Then-acting ICE Director **Todd Lyons** called Iranian repatriation a "priority" days after President Donald Trump warned Tehran residents to evacuate, and an ICE official described the deportations as a "White House priority" despite Iran's closed airspace.
* A separate lawsuit filed by Iranian asylum seekers in July alleges ICE illegally shared confidential information with Iranian officials while the migrants were in detention.
* **Trans migrants in ICE detention losing rights, medical care, NYT finds** : The federal government has halted specialized care for transgender detainees at more than 10 immigration detention centers and deleted an Obama-era policy assuring the basic rights of transgender people in immigration custody, according to a Thursday [report](https://substack.com/redirect/11222516-2201-4214-9aec-8f2300045e5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from The New York Times.
* **Camila Toro de Paula** , a 25-year-old transgender Venezuelan asylum seeker who has spent 11 months in a men's facility in Jena, Louisiana, described being assaulted, denied hormone treatment, and held in solitary confinement without consistent water access to the Times.
* Another transgender asylum seeker, **Wilmar Quintero** , who left her native Venezuela after being tortured by police officers for her transgender identity, described being sexually assaulted while detained in Michigan before she was deported in April.
* **DHS spied on at least five Midwest churches amid anti-ICE activist probe, court records show:** Court filings that emerged last week [reveal](https://substack.com/redirect/71c9cd41-ae9f-41da-bf45-4e152c2d4648?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) DHS agents surveilled five churches in Minnesota and Michigan as part of an investigation into activists opposing ICE known as "Operation Puppet Master."
* Undercover agents attended events at First Universalist Church of Minneapolis and University Baptist Church, with one undercover agent attending a Mixed Martial Arts class at University Baptist Church in May with a hidden audio recorder, and another agent collecting license plate information near St. John the Evangelist Episcopal Church in St. Paul during an April activist meeting.
* The revelations raise questions about whether DHS violated a February court injunction barring warrantless enforcement actions at churches.
* **Texas Gov. Abbott targets Muslim washing stations at airports** : Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott**[ sent](https://substack.com/redirect/8c45abe6-a8bb-42dc-b3bc-ba4ebc7b4241?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a letter Friday to the heads of Houston and Dallas-Fort Worth airports alleging that their Muslim wudu washing stations constituted "religious discrimination." Abbott, has consistently pursued anti-Muslim policies, asked the U.S. Department of Transportation to investigate and warned his office is "reviewing all grants" to entities involved, according to The Washington Post.
* **Missouri judge allows Trump-backed congressional map for November election** : Cole County Circuit Judge **Daniel Green** [ruled](https://substack.com/redirect/40c1defe-42e0-4145-b50f-8667abd8cba5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Wednesday that Missouri's new Republican-friendly U.S. House districts can be used in November, rejecting a bid by the group People Not Politicians to put the map to a statewide referendum.
* The redistricting, prompted by President Donald Trump's push for Republican-led states to redraw boundaries ahead of the midterms, targets Democratic Rep. **Emanuel Cleaver** by splitting Kansas City among Republican-held districts and extending his 5th District into rural GOP territory, with about 59% of the district's voters newly assigned under the plan.
* People Not Politicians executive director **Richard von Glahn** said the group plans to appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court.
* Missouri's fight joins roughly a dozen lawsuits nationally over redistricting efforts that could net Republicans up to 16 additional House seats across eight states.
* **Research finds over 150 Polymarket wallets likely traded on inside U.S. military information:** More than 150 wallets on Polymarket International [appear](https://substack.com/redirect/195c220d-5f37-4026-87b0-1ba787dece83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to have traded on insider U.S. military information, collectively earning $8 million with a 97.2% win rate on defense-related bets, according to research from the nonprofit Anti-Corruption Data Collective.
* ACDC also found that bets from these accounts appear to attract copycat wagers from larger traders and automated bots, including $200,000 and $100,000 copycat bets placed hours before June 2025 U.S. strikes on Iran.
* **Private prison giant GEO Group donated $1.4 million to pro-Trump PAC after landing major ICE contracts** : GEO Group's reentry services division contributed $1.4 million to MAGA Inc., a super PAC supporting President Donald Trump, in July, according to Federal Election Commission records reviewed by The Lever, just weeks after the company secured two five-year Department of Homeland Security contracts to operate ICE detention facilities in Colorado and North Carolina worth a combined estimated $165 million in annual revenue.
* The Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment recently sued GEO Group, forcing the company to allow state inspectors to investigate a tuberculosis outbreak at one of its facilities.
* More on the GEO Group's political activities is available from The Lever [here](https://substack.com/redirect/e74b9d49-cb8b-40bf-af86-813b51b8536b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
