name: Kirk Cameron
subject: The Christian response to drag queen story hour
body:
We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded
ALA.

View in Web Browser [/https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e12560134/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvVmNVa1dyVlJtQQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA4MjE/LbmNsZXpCUzhlNw/qP2hpZHM9bmNNbHJTMHBlaGxLcGdsc10/gaojPmA/s2l3cca0e01

Friend,

If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox
News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, PLEASE LET ME
TELL YOU WHY IT’S SO CRITICAL.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the
library with a kind but stern librarian.

She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny _and _The
Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam
by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_,
_Treasure Island _and _Charlotte’s Web_.

BUT TODAY, ALL THAT HAS CHANGED.

Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of
the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used
to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+
writers and voices.’

Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn _and _To Kill
a Mockingbird _“racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls
Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her
“problematic’ _Little House _series.

And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for
“Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to
children of all ages...

A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their
kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism,
environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else
that activists believe in and fight for.”

Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a
new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the
air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change
the world.”

Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a
prince who marries a knight instead of a princess.

And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A
“family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to
“work it.”

I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New
York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.

[Image showing people, person, and baby]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour”

THAT’S WHY PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS ACROSS THE COUNTRY ARE RISING UP
THROUGH SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and
George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.

AND AS A RESULT, A NEW GENERATION OF PINK-HAIRED, ACTIVIST LIBRARIANS
HAVE MADE IT THEIR MISSION TO FILL LIBRARY SHELVES WITH ANTI-AMERICAN,
LGBTQ-FRIENDLY, AND EXPLICITLY SEXUAL CONTENT.

Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library
celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type
of religion.

Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to
be a “parent-free” zone.

The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick _about a
cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa _filled with graphic nudity, and
_Darkstalker _featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.

BUT HERE’S WHAT’S REALLY ALARMING.

We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my
family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t
check out those inappropriate books.”

That may be good for your family -- for now.

BUT MEANWHILE, THE ALA USES OUR TAXPAYER-FUNDED LIBRARIES TO LURE IN
MILLIONS OF OTHER CHILDREN WHO GROW UP TO BE THE VERY ACTIVISTS WHO
ARE DESTROYING OUR COUNTRY AND CONSERVATIVE VALUES!

I HOPE YOU SEE WHY I NEED YOUR HELP TODAY.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

My name is Kirk Cameron.

Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing
Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof”
and “Left Behind.”

I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist
values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.

But the gospel saved me.

I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a
husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.

When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to
indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America
messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.

So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children
how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.

THEN I DECIDED TO GO ONE STEP FURTHER AND COUNTER THOSE AWFUL “DRAG
QUEEN STORY HOURS” WITH CONSERVATIVE STORY HOURS FILLED WITH THE
CLASSIC BOOKS YOU AND I GREW UP WITH, PLUS NEW WHOLESOME BOOKS LIKE
MINE THAT CAPTIVATE CHILDREN WITH LESSONS IN BRAVERY, HONESTY,
KINDNESS, AND PATRIOTISM.

And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit.

* Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.

* The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out
including booking all the event rooms for themselves.

* Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi
(that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse
and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored
moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and
on.

I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so
vile.

In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them
that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.

AND THOUSANDS OF PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS BROUGHT THEIR LITTLE ONES TO
THOSE “STORY HOURS” WHERE WE PLEDGED ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG, SANG
“GOD BLESS AMERICA”, AND READ WHOLESOME AND GODLY BOOKS.

It was incredible.

But here’s the greatest part...

From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could
host “Story Hours” of their own.

And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement
was born.

Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at
201 libraries in 46 states.

On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”

filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.

Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a
very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and
reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries.

AND THIS YEAR, HONORING AMERICA’S 250TH BIRTHDAY, MY AMBITIOUS GOAL
IS TO EXPAND “SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY” TO REACH 250,000
CHILDREN.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you!

The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host
“Story Hours” has been overwhelming.

That’s a very good thing.

But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these
volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for
250,000 children.

THAT’S WHY I’VE TEAMED WITH A VERY SPECIAL NON-PROFIT CALLED BRAVE
FOR GOOD TO MAKE THIS YEAR’S “SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY” A
BIGGER SUCCESS THAN EVER.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

BRAVE FOR GOOD was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian
publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots
were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with
a tax-deductible gift.

YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT HELPS SEND A ‘STORY HOUR KIT’ TO EVERY
PARENT, GRANDPARENT, AND PATRIOT WHO’S ORGANIZING A “SEE YOU AT
THE LIBRARY” EVENT.

The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative
values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their
library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for
little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards,
and other specialty items.

YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT IS THE ONLY WAY WE CAN FUND OUR “STORY
HOURS” FOR 250,000 CHILDREN TO COUNTER THE RADICAL LEFTISTS WHO’VE
TAKEN CONTROL OF OUR LIBRARIES.

We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded
ALA.

KNOWING THAT, PLEASE CONSIDER A SPONSORSHIP GIFT OF $125. THAT’S
ENOUGH TO SPONSOR ONE ENTIRE ‘STORY HOUR KIT’ YOURSELF.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome,
Godly, and patriotic message.

WHATEVER YOU CAN GIVE WHETHER IT’S $35, $125, OR ANYTHING HIGHER OR
LOWER PLEASE SEND IN YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT IN THE NEXT 48 HOURS SO WE
KNOW HOW MANY LIBRARIES WE HAVE SPONSORED FOR THIS YEAR’S “SEE YOU
AT THE LIBRARY DAY.”
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,

KIRK CAMERON

Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series. And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.” I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true. [Image showing people, person, and baby] [ THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour” THAT’S WHY PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS ACROSS THE COUNTRY ARE RISING UP THROUGH SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY. [ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. AND AS A RESULT, A NEW GENERATION OF PINK-HAIRED, ACTIVIST LIBRARIANS HAVE MADE IT THEIR MISSION TO FILL LIBRARY SHELVES WITH ANTI-AMERICAN, LGBTQ-FRIENDLY, AND EXPLICITLY SEXUAL CONTENT. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. BUT HERE’S WHAT’S REALLY ALARMING. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family -- for now. BUT MEANWHILE, THE ALA USES OUR TAXPAYER-FUNDED LIBRARIES TO LURE IN MILLIONS OF OTHER CHILDREN WHO GROW UP TO BE THE VERY ACTIVISTS WHO ARE DESTROYING OUR COUNTRY AND CONSERVATIVE VALUES! I HOPE YOU SEE WHY I NEED YOUR HELP TODAY. [ My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. THEN I DECIDED TO GO ONE STEP FURTHER AND COUNTER THOSE AWFUL “DRAG QUEEN STORY HOURS” WITH CONSERVATIVE STORY HOURS FILLED WITH THE CLASSIC BOOKS YOU AND I GREW UP WITH, PLUS NEW WHOLESOME BOOKS LIKE MINE THAT CAPTIVATE CHILDREN WITH LESSONS IN BRAVERY, HONESTY, KINDNESS, AND PATRIOTISM. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour. The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. * Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. AND THOUSANDS OF PARENTS AND GRANDPARENTS BROUGHT THEIR LITTLE ONES TO THOSE “STORY HOURS” WHERE WE PLEDGED ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG, SANG “GOD BLESS AMERICA”, AND READ WHOLESOME AND GODLY BOOKS. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own. And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours” filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. AND THIS YEAR, HONORING AMERICA’S 250TH BIRTHDAY, MY AMBITIOUS GOAL IS TO EXPAND “SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY” TO REACH 250,000 CHILDREN. [ The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming. That’s a very good thing. But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. THAT’S WHY I’VE TEAMED WITH A VERY SPECIAL NON-PROFIT CALLED BRAVE FOR GOOD TO MAKE THIS YEAR’S “SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY” A BIGGER SUCCESS THAN EVER. [ BRAVE FOR GOOD was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift. YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT HELPS SEND A ‘STORY HOUR KIT’ TO EVERY PARENT, GRANDPARENT, AND PATRIOT WHO’S ORGANIZING A “SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY” EVENT. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT IS THE ONLY WAY WE CAN FUND OUR “STORY HOURS” FOR 250,000 CHILDREN TO COUNTER THE RADICAL LEFTISTS WHO’VE TAKEN CONTROL OF OUR LIBRARIES. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. KNOWING THAT, PLEASE CONSIDER A SPONSORSHIP GIFT OF $125. THAT’S ENOUGH TO SPONSOR ONE ENTIRE ‘STORY HOUR KIT’ YOURSELF. [ Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. WHATEVER YOU CAN GIVE WHETHER IT’S $35, $125, OR ANYTHING HIGHER OR LOWER PLEASE SEND IN YOUR SPONSORSHIP GIFT IN THE NEXT 48 HOURS SO WE KNOW HOW MANY LIBRARIES WE HAVE SPONSORED FOR THIS YEAR’S “SEE YOU AT THE LIBRARY DAY.” [ Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America, KIRK CAMERON [I'm an image] [I'm an image] DONATE [ DONATE [ [Image showing logo and text] [ 100 I-45 N 260 Conroe, TX 77301

A deranged "TikTok lawyer" tried to **[scream in an ICE agent's face](https://substack.com/redirect/638e7050-1640-46d6-91cf-501fc180cd63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during an enforcement operation.
It did not end well for her at all... _" If you get in my face again we'll have a problem!!" _
## [Watch what happened: ](https://substack.com/redirect/638e7050-1640-46d6-91cf-501fc180cd63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/638e7050-1640-46d6-91cf-501fc180cd63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
# **SCOTUS lets Trump 's White House ballroom construction continue for now**
Chief Justice John Roberts **[issued a one-sentence order Friday allowing work](https://substack.com/redirect/75103feb-c1bc-4c60-bc22-c7f5fb744102?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Trump's $400 million White House "Military/Ballroom Complex" to proceed while the Supreme Court considers the administration's emergency appeal, hours before a lower court order would have halted construction.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/75103feb-c1bc-4c60-bc22-c7f5fb744102?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Solicitor General D. John Sauer argued** the project -- already 65% complete, with a 250-person crew working around the clock -- is needed for Trump's security following assassination threats, and that stopping it would render the legal fight moot. Two lower courts had previously ruled the project unlawful without congressional approval.
* **Court filings revealed the underground structure includes bomb shelters,** sniper nests, a drone port, and blast-resistant materials. The National Trust for Historic Preservation is suing to block the project, while the administration disputes the group's standing to challenge it.

* * *
# **Elon Musk plans up to $200M GOP push ahead of midterms**
Elon Musk is **[reportedly relaunching America PAC, spending $100-200 million](https://substack.com/redirect/22d214a9-e5f7-43c3-ab51-7ac6f13d7a69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on door-knocking, digital ads, and direct mail to boost Republican turnout in battleground states ahead of November, with a major focus on Texas's competitive Senate race.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/22d214a9-e5f7-43c3-ab51-7ac6f13d7a69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The move marks a reversal after Musk 's public 2025 falling out with Trump** over Epstein-related accusations; the two reconciled at Charlie Kirk's memorial, and Musk has since acknowledged getting "carried away" during his time leading DOGE.
* **The investment adds to Republicans ' financial edge **-- Trump's super PAC holds roughly $400 million versus the DNC's reported $2 million debt -- as the GOP faces headwinds including high gas prices, the Iran conflict, and polling showing Democrats ahead by about 6.5 points on the generic congressional ballot.

* * *
# **JD Vance touts $1B steel plant investment in hometown**
Vice President JD Vance spoke at an event in his hometown of Middletown, Ohio, **[marking a $1 billion investment](https://substack.com/redirect/42183e03-0c58-4cb5-b76b-9cb06eeacea8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** into Cleveland-Cliffs' Middletown Works steel plant, backed by a $500 million Department of Energy award, with work set to begin in coming weeks over a four-year rollout.
## [Watch:](https://substack.com/redirect/b98ef705-7a85-441b-b0a4-9de7871014fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b98ef705-7a85-441b-b0a4-9de7871014fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/b98ef705-7a85-441b-b0a4-9de7871014fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **The investment includes a new cogeneration facility to capture blast furnace gas for on-site power and steam,** aimed at cutting energy costs, with the blast furnace rebuild expected to finish in early 2030; the project is projected to employ over 1,500 workers at peak construction.
* **Vance, whose grandfather worked at the same plant as a welder, credited the Trump administration** with bringing manufacturing jobs back to the U.S. and criticized Democratic policies while backing Ohio candidates in attendance.

Tell Congress: No Immunity for Big Oil!

Congressional Republicans are considering legislation to give Big Oil blanket
immunity from state laws and lawsuits that could hold them accountable for
fueling the climate crisis and the harm they cause people and our planet.

Again and again, Big Oil has lied to protect its profits. And now, Big Oil just made $85.2 BILLION in profits as American families struggle to pay their bills and make ends meet.

We won’t stand for it. Everyday people have a right to make these corporations
pay for the harm and destruction they cause. Join LCV and urge your member of Congress to reject any calls for immunity from
Big Oil today.

laws and lawsuits that could hold them accountable for fueling the climate

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. Hi there, I hope you are well!
[This is Michele Tafoya – I’ve got a quick story to share if you’ll indulge me for a few moments.](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=1c7b170c238d406f98e3a5fd4a1877b1&_e=uNahTXjuhoXLq5GWZZu5tjTBI8RbUkSUlu30bS0nybSKWR2WGSGD0OaxH-iue0ssHBXs8-d8CneunmV3CfjOG8Cx0BKnPiTwdffTarYqDJPCZ8PWStuQGFSL8u8tpXPYtEbBdu4CwH9xnEx2q7PmbVLQuJracbphXwg5r5teCnPNZBsJUUMvVXyJHgnR91nY53Csa5UPb2wDLaHelXH4IlE7LSoCY-Hado5rnBZX8RaVg8qzDSwD6FJzLULFWrM9wWUwIwOeP1OR_UPGlFyyHMqpY1Xg_DhPfOOpXhW8X2ez-nzEjJ8-_6XPCbjWE1D5JMj_TWn4FoJYeiw6Etbzfj13Hw31pJZvOz5fRgHswPg--KaoSqLZ0gjPtjrbr6Bn8ZA_ecq5rFOSidZpUvXs5AWFEQ1lXD5IRRLN5bYMJtwXdSlEOCSyd2H-Xq8qLbIrI16tZKqSMAyflUUD7CbvncqH2DUhTmLisQnHmdd2Te6upQtiFuO3Phb3qEY3okdzr34_MfHBPq4bdC-Ps4_81WjZUHMeNuqOAMe2rASLvuIJtS5sueQFESCtrWh44Slk7RcmFKEz34mOPQ3WZr-TK30jlrkvgR9eewN-I8jw699c9ODIHrf9k07L5VwGasemNedm_4SlEPSnVjTRIDmiOZiXvIaavhuDihGRRDF0-rL-56QT5JGERqETUJd43oxz6V1PmsoHV6TSCmNZmFdccg%3D%3D)
Folks might've killed to have my job.
I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary.
I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem:
I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative.
So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind.
---
[](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=1c7b170c238d406f98e3a5fd4a1877b1&_e=uNahTXjuhoXLq5GWZZu5tjTBI8RbUkSUlu30bS0nybSKWR2WGSGD0OaxH-iue0ssHBXs8-d8CneunmV3CfjOG8Cx0BKnPiTwdffTarYqDJPCZ8PWStuQGFSL8u8tpXPYtEbBdu4CwH9xnEx2q7PmbVLQuJracbphXwg5r5teCnPNZBsJUUMvVXyJHgnR91nY53Csa5UPb2wDLaHelXH4IlE7LSoCY-Hado5rnBZX8RaVg8qzDSwD6FJzLULFWrM9I_2-sM2uvnLxUhnhB33CT5ulGBiOtz6DcEfDnGASFFqLtM20f1oNr41dErZhobnBK6YXGUQWCUUTCf29bUzOiOJad0dlZ5lhPutM32fCg4_rZKKUAB3xsU0tOI366q0Z_93nt7qbqAUp4V7gFoDRw4aYRmqinGLHR-uP3_amrYyXyTIxW2MGjBrkH7Gbua7HqF5NiWJVeiU1JfpXoKPSttaFJCP2mPuWOyVI15Dn3CceWyQEeNOmvuT91bPUZIvDdZTX82xvDMtRoIHHbfvGDaiA4T2O4zHHoCyBUjj2aPjrcc7RPWdOpbu4c1mDbFd-aFrrbZEHlfY0_p8BYOG5jzr7jUikp78q24-NxAu8sZlut7czakY4628xAGnkmqMnOjayeSf08vSIx4XTLSZQbGYm1B6PCHtzkVBRSKVHiBfPcOolNGRqGWw0cDXv4U7uwfjMBoWmbKxfyGfuJutiFA%3D%3D)

It was the hardest decision I've ever made. I was scared, excited, and liberated - all at the same time. ** ** People said I was OUT OF MY MIND. ** ** But I knew God was leading me in a certain direction, and that's no time for half-measures. I knew he had a plan for my life. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back. ** ** [Now, a few years later, I’ve started a growing podcast, campaigned for commonsense in Minnesota, and now launched a campaign for U.S. Senate!](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=1c7b170c238d406f98e3a5fd4a1877b1&_e=uNahTXjuhoXLq5GWZZu5tjTBI8RbUkSUlu30bS0nybSKWR2WGSGD0OaxH-iue0ssHBXs8-d8CneunmV3CfjOG8Cx0BKnPiTwdffTarYqDJPCZ8PWStuQGFSL8u8tpXPYtEbBdu4CwH9xnEx2q7PmbVLQuJracbphXwg5r5teCnPNZBsJUUMvVXyJHgnR91nY53Csa5UPb2wDLaHelXH4IlE7LSoCY-Hado5rnBZX8RaVg8qzDSwD6FJzLULFWrM9LDbt0VkqQptB-wsQ20k1OePdVahir6CA6eoLcoeotRhCUlrRpsW_ox0G0OHn7i_OmqBJixGivgx_HdQHyO1LlFp40c45N9g1eSbL3PXfKgquMjudFfIiLxTfTwPeiiXaCRrNvgQ5pY_pP5RDYmMf_M00uVH9WFRT6EWb_wL2QJTfZwo35HkwZPvipIYoeqckoGtWCuB3Nm8oHAmDjyfhMUpRPdKNF6ZZ5FlubNN7RLSh3NPZ1QRyC8972_xbHPtQbf7VDy3SlUD5AczJBK4xOxgXtUsds2xImoLoe1Y83swXDm1CRXkeqhpcEUTG0b4KpegrqGvfB7eMLiY-BmokHDf09VMn6dAAibWtCHP608xwgn6kdAb0LOd66VT8ygCjzQs_IElh1VMyBqUvHYG1XFGj_ojJprn1I9BygpdUErJCBwSsfgdcTTVaZg8xJZuNzEZ9w77prBZ1KxqqI86s0g%3D%3D) ** ** I believe God put me here for a reason. ** ** I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. ** ** And I believe a no-BS, sane person who's ALL-IN can win this seat. ** ** But I'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. ** ** Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. ** ** My finance team tells me we'll need to bring in donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. ** ** I'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one. clean_body: This is Michele Tafoya – I’ve got a quick story to share if you’ll indulge me for a few moments. | Hi there, I hope you are well! Folks might've killed to have my job. I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary. I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem: I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative. So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind. It was the hardest decision I've ever made. I was scared, excited, and liberated - all at the same time. People said I was OUT OF MY MIND. But I knew God was leading me in a certain direction, and that's no time for half-measures. I knew he had a plan for my life. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back. I believe God put me here for a reason. I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. And I believe a no-BS, sane person who's ALL-IN can win this seat. But I'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. My finance team tells me we'll need to bring in donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. I'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one. | I put my career on hold to speak out for what I know to be true. I'm committing my blood, sweat, and tears to take this seat back from the political class. I'd be honored if you'd be willing to stand alongside me. Any type of donations will make a impact on our path to victory. I hope you'll join us, but either way, God bless you! Be brave. Do good. - Michele Michele Tafoya Republican for Senate, Minnesota It's official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! subject: what we’ve built + where we’re going
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Thank you for all that your support has made possible. Help us stay in the fight through Election Day.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260821-1&t=1&akid=3907%2E587540%2E4Fv0HP)
75 days until Election Day, Peter.
And I want to take a moment to say thank you.
Leaders We Deserve has had the biggest cycle in our entire history. We’ve already won 34 elections and have elected 1 current member of Congress, and 3 presumptive members. Our state legislative record? 25-2.
Here’s just a snapshot of what _you_ made happen:
* **Mayor Mamdani:** Leaders We Deserve was his largest organizational funder in the primary spending $300,000, while the establishment lost its mind. He won and is now one of the most popular elected officials in America, delivering on his campaign promises almost immediately.
* **Christian Menefee** was elected to Congress with Leaders We Deserve’s support, not once but twice! A former Harris County Attorney, Christian’s now taking Trump and Epstein collaborators to task on the Oversight Committee.
* **Donovan McKinney** won his congressional primary in MI-13. We replaced a corrupt Democratic Congressman with a progressive State Legislator who’s fighting against utility corporations jacking up prices.
* **Demi Palecek won her primary to serve in the Illinois Statehouse, despite being outspent 9-1 by a gambling industry lobbyist. She stood tall against ICE when they harassed her neighbors in Chicago, and will keep up the fight when she’s sworn in.**
* Ismael Luna was our first challenger to oust a state legislative incumbent. Ismael, who was homeless as a teenager and now works to get youth housing, beat a Wisconsin lawmaker who threatened to shoot her colleagues...no seriously.
* **Claire Valdez** is headed to Congress in NY-07 after crushing the establishment’s pick by 25 points. A union organizer, Claire will push for workers’ and tenant’s rights in Congress.
* **Akbar Ali** , the youngest lawmaker in Georgia history, called Republicans’ bluff and forced them to pass a suspension of the gas tax – putting money back in Georgians pockets during Trump’s forever war that’s raising gas prices through the roof.
* **Randy Villegas** beat an establishment-backed candidate who shared over 50 corporate donors with the Republican incumbent in CA-22. Now, he’s running on a platform of being unbought and unbossed in the Central Valley.

Your support made this happen. We don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, we are powered by Americans like you chipping in whatever you can.

When I first met Roy Cooper, he was greeting North Carolinians as their attorney general. His demeanor was down-to-earth, and he gave every person his full attention.
Roy served as North Carolina’s governor from 2017 until 2025, when term limits required him to leave office. **And now he’s running to serve in the U.S. Senate.**
[**_Will you join me in supporting Roy right now with whatever you can afford? Even if it’s only a dollar, small donations add up!_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1196&amount=5&t=9&akid=2909%2E124072%2EEQHXeU)
Roy’s opponent, Michael Whatley, is endorsed by the MAGA leader who cares more about the Reflecting Pool than the cost of groceries.
Whatley is an election denier who doesn’t care about the price of gas or how many North Carolinians are relying on food banks. He’d vote for the nearly $2 BILLION slush fund that would transfer millions of our tax dollars to January Sixers.
Think of all the meals and gas that could buy.
[**_Don’t let the election denier buy a seat in the U.S. Senate. Roy will have the votes to win if we help him reach more North Carolinians._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1196&amount=5&t=10&akid=2909%2E124072%2EEQHXeU)

body:
We’re aiming for 50 canvasses and 10 phone banks that you can be a part of.
#
Hi there,
Last month, Swing Left volunteers helped turn our very first 2026 Weekend of Action into our biggest Ground Truth push yet. Together, volunteers knocked on 3,024 doors and had 587 substantive conversations across 23 canvasses and 5 phone banks in 19 critical target races.
Ground Truth is Swing Left’s innovative voter-contact program where volunteers knock on doors and have real, substantive conversations with voters that start with listening—in order to rebuild trust with Democrats and win elections.
As of today, we have just 73 days until Election Day. We’re at an inflection point: if we’re going to talk with voters in all of the places we need to win, we have to supercharge the number of doors we’re knocking each week.
**That’s what the Swing Left community is coming together to do on August 29th and 30th.** Our goal for this month’s Weekend of Action is to stress test our ground game: We want to hold 50 Ground Truth canvasses and 10 virtual phone banks in just two days. This push is critical as we scale up to have 500,000 substantive conversations with voters in the swing districts that will decide control of Congress this year and for years to come.
Whether you’ve volunteered with Swing Left in the past or never volunteered before, we’ll make sure you head out with the training, tools, and support you need to feel confident.
Here’s how you can be a part of next weekend:
**[The most impactful thing you can do to help Democrats win is joining a canvass near you to talk with voters in the swing districts and states we need to win this November.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2282?utm_content=em20260821-2534&t=1&akid=2534%2E1562180%2Effm-_2)**
Don’t live near a swing district, or have a busy weekend? You can still take action: [**Make calls from the comfort of home to connect with voters in high-stakes districts nationwide.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2278?=utm_source%3Dem20260821-2534&t=2&akid=2534%2E1562180%2Effm-_2)
There are just over ten weeks left before November. Every conversation we have now helps build the relationships and organizing power we’ll need to help Democrats flip the House, win back the Senate, and put a necessary check on Trump. We hope you’ll join us next weekend in whatever way works best for you!
Z Mooney
Voter Contact Director, Swing Left

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260821-1&t=3&refcode2=2534_1562180_ffm-_2&akid=2534%2E1562180%2Effm-_2)
